About EnglishVidya

Learn English — Even If You Know Nothing!

Welcome to EnglishVidya, a platform born out of necessity, built through extreme struggle, and driven by a single mission: to make English easy, practical, and accessible for every Hindi-medium student in India.

🎯 Our Mission & Vision

  • Our Mission: At EnglishVidya, we help Hindi-speaking students from class 6 to 12 learn English from the basics. We teach using a mix of Hindi and English so students can understand better. Our goal is to make English learning easy, clear, and helpful for every student.
  • Our Vision: We want to become the one-stop solution for every student who knows Hindi and wants to learn English. We want to boost their confidence so they can succeed in studies, jobs, and daily life.
  • Our Deepest Purpose: Beyond teaching English, our true purpose is to uplift and empower Hindi-medium students, help them grow in confidence, and develop strong communication skills to achieve success in school and in life. We want them to think deeply, speak clearly, and live with dignity.

👨‍🏫 Meet Our Founder

EnglishVidya was founded by Master Manikant, a dedicated educator with STET and B.Ed. credentials. He has a passion for simplifying English grammar and literature for Hindi-medium students. Know more about our Founder & Author.

📚 Who We Teach

  • Grammar: Class 6 to 12 students (all over India).
  • Books & Literature: NCERT for Class 6–8, and Bihar Board focus for Class 9–12.

🌟 What Makes Us Different?

  1. Bilingual Approach: Mix of Hindi-English for easy learning.
  2. Practical & Exam-Oriented: Focus on real-life examples and solid exam preparation.
  3. Value-Based Education: Teaches moral values along with English lessons.
  4. Comprehensive Practice: Includes quizzes, MCQs, PYQs, videos, and more.
  5. The 'Dual-Definition' System: Every grammar concept is taught twice—a simple definition for quick learning, and an advanced definition hidden in a dropdown for competitive exams.
  6. Personal Verification: Everything is personally verified by Master Manikant.

🚀 What’s Coming Next

We’re starting Zoom live classes for Class 10 & 12 book sections. Soon, you’ll also be able to learn through our mobile app, just like the website.
